items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the cohomology sheaves of a derived pushforward as the sheafification of the presheaf V maps to H^i(u(V), K), which is also H^i(V, Rf_*K) (statement lines 4433-4443). The proof uses a K-injective representative so that the pushforward is computed naively (proof lines 4445-4448), identifies the resulting presheaf of cohomology with the one displayed, and sheafifies, the alternative description following from the companion Leray identification (proof lines 4448-4450). The non-formal content is the identification of the presheaves. The claim is H2: one representative choice plus one identification.
